notes: Full-universe run: every coin listed as a perp on BOTH Hyperliquid and Lighter (exact symbol match), same 208-day window as the 3-coin run, same Strategy E parameters (MIN_NET_APR 70%). Blacklisted coins were not fetched or simulated (strategy never opens them).

Simulation logic imported UNCHANGED from backtest_strategy_e.py (v0.5.3: funding accrues from the position's fixed legs; spread history is signed per direction). Transport is curl (urllib IncompleteReads through the VM proxy); fetch code mirrors the script's fetch functions (same endpoints, chunking, parsing).

Volume gates NOT applied (no historical per-venue volume in public endpoints). Slippage NOT modeled (no historical book data). Hard stop evaluated at hour closes only (hourly cycle cadence), not intra-hour. Per-leg liquidation is NOT modeled (a leg liquidating intra-hour is not in the model).
Lighter fundings `rate` is a PERCENT string, signed by `direction` (calibrated live 2026-11-16).

near_misses_not_matched: Lighter lists 1000BONK/1000FLOKI/1000NOT/1000PEPE/1000SHIB/1000TOSHI while Hyperliquid lists kBONK/kFLOKI/kNOT/kPEPE/kSHIB/kTOSHI (same underlying at 1000x scale, different tickers).
